# Panels

```{tabularcolumns} |\Y{0.2}|\Y{0.15}|\Y{0.65}|
```

| Panel | Opens on the | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| {ref}`Structure <panel-info_dock>` | left | Read-only summary of the active document. |
| {ref}`Workspace <panel-file_dock>` | left | The workspace tree, with the filesystem browser beside it. |
| {ref}`Modules <panel-modules_dock>` | left | The module tree, and the Stop button for what it started. |
| {ref}`Inspector <panel-inspector_dock>` | right | Properties of the current selection. |
| {ref}`Net <panel-net_dock>` | right | The identification of the net in the active document. |
| {ref}`Sites <panel-sites_dock>` | right | The site table, kept in step with the viewport selection. |
| {ref}`Move <panel-move_dock>` | right | Numeric transformations of the current selection. |
| {ref}`Style <panel-style_dock>` | right | Draw style, sizes, colours, labels and the legend. |
| {ref}`Measure <panel-measure_dock>` | right | Distances, angles and torsions taken in the viewport. |
| {ref}`Force Field <panel-ff_dock>` | right | Atom types, a single point, and a geometry optimisation. |
| {ref}`DFTB+ <panel-dftb_dock>` | right | Atom types, a single point, and a geometry optimisation. |
| {ref}`Trajectory <panel-trajectory_dock>` | bottom | Scrub a trajectory against the open structure. |
| {ref}`Log <panel-log_dock>` | bottom | A read-only monospaced view of one log file. |
| {ref}`Results <panel-results_dock>` | bottom | The report from the last module run. |
